Riding Horses/ Riding Camels: This rule affects movement Units with this special rule arrive on the battlefield mounted, and then dismount to fight. There is no need to models the horses unless you wish to do so. Units Riding Horses may make an additional move of up to 8” as a Special Deployment move. The horses are then taken to the rear and take no further part in the battle. Units Riding Camels make an additional move of up to 6” as a Special Deployment move, and the Tethered Camels rule then applies.
